jobs.title: Risk and Compliance Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the role:

Replit is building the security GRC function that will scale with an AI-native product. As the Risk & Compliance lead, you'll own our certification and audit program end to end: SOC 2, ISO 27001, and eventually ISO 42001 (AI management systems), while also owning the company's master security risk register and continuous compliance monitoring. You'll report to the Head of Security GRC, who retains overall accountability for the risk program, and work closely with Engineering to make sure controls hold up in practice, not just on paper.


What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end certification roadmap (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and future frameworks like ISO 42001) including scoping, gap assessments, remediation, and audit execution

  • Manage relationships with external auditors and drive the annual audit calendar so certifications renew without last-minute scrambles

  • Own and maintain the company's master security risk register including risk identification, scoring methodology, treatment plans, and residual risk reporting

  • Build and maintain continuous compliance monitoring so control status reflects real-time state rather than point-in-time snapshots

  • Own the core audit artifacts that back every certification including ISMS documentation, Statements of Applicability, risk assessments, and potentially FedRAMP System Security Plans (SSPs)

  • Run regular audits and readiness assessments, and track remediation of findings and control gaps to closure

  • Support GDPR and broader privacy compliance alongside the Legal/Privacy team, without owning the legal interpretation of requirements

  • Partner with the GRC Engineer to define what evidence collection and control monitoring should be automated versus manually reviewed

  • Track and report on compliance posture and audit findings to security leadership


Required Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years in security compliance, IT audit, or GRC roles, with direct ownership of at least one SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 certification cycle

  • Working knowledge of common frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF) and how to map controls across them

  • Hands-on experience authoring or substantially maintaining an ISMS, SSP, or equivalent audit-facing documentation set and not just filling out a template

  • Experience owning a formal risk register including risk identification, scoring methodology, treatment plans, and residual risk reporting to leadership

  • Experience with GRC/compliance automation platforms (e.g., Anecdotes, Vanta, Drata, etc.) and continuous control monitoring

  • Experience working directly with external auditors and managing an audit end to end

  • Comfortable reading technical control evidence and having detailed conversations with engineers about how systems actually work

  • Working familiarity with GDPR/privacy fundamentals sufficient to partner effectively with a legal team


Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience scoping or pursuing ISO 42001 or other AI governance frameworks

  • Familiarity with FedRAMP or other government compliance regimes

  • Background in a developer tools, platform, or AI/ML product company

  • Relevant certifications (CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer)

  • Experience standing up a compliance program from an early or pre-certification stage

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Senior AI Builder
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


The AI Studio is the team responsible for designing, building, and operationalizing internal software platforms across every functional department of the company, including People Operations, Customer Support, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Recruiting, and Executive Operations. We treat each internal department as its own product surface, and in truth as its own startup, with its own customers, its own metrics, and its own reasons for existing. We ship custom software, built on Replit’s own platform, to solve operational problems that off-the-shelf SaaS tools cannot serve well at our scale and pace of growth.

Position Summary

The Member of Technical Staff (AI Builder) is a full-time builder role with substantial autonomy. You will design, architect, and ship AI-powered internal platforms that run the operations of the company across many departments at once. This is not a role for someone who wants a narrow, well-defined lane. It is a role for someone who wants to walk into an ambiguous business problem, understand it well enough to argue about it with the department lead, and then ship the software that fixes it.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the Role

We're redefining how software is built and who gets to build it. Our mission is to achieve Autonomy for All: making programming accessible, collaborative, and powered by AI. Realizing that vision requires a platform that legitimate users can trust and adversarial actors cannot exploit.

We're hiring a Data Scientist to help build Replit's Trust & Safety and Anti-Abuse program from the ground up. You'll turn noisy behavioral, identity, payment, infrastructure, and content signals into the measurement systems, detections, and decisions that protect Replit's users, platform, and economics. You'll work closely with Engineering, Support, Legal, Security, Infrastructure, Money, and Growth to make abuse economically unviable while keeping friction low for legitimate users.

Replit sits at the frontier of AI-native abuse. Our platform is a target for phishing and scam hosting, cryptomining, LLM token farming, card and coupon fraud, referral abuse, and increasingly, abuse driven by AI agents themselves. You'll help define how we identify, measure, and respond to these threats without compromising the experience of good users.


Who You Are

You're a data scientist who moves fast, goes deep, and thinks adversarially. You can spin up an analysis in hours that would take others days, not by cutting corners, but because you've built the intuition and technical toolkit to get to the right answer quickly. You dig past the top-line abuse rate to understand selection effects, missing labels, policy changes, attacker adaptation, and the false positives hidden inside an aggregate metric.

You understand that Trust & Safety data is imperfect and outcomes are high stakes. Ground truth is delayed, biased, and often incomplete; attackers react to defenses; and an apparently effective rule can quietly harm legitimate users. You pressure-test your own work, quantify uncertainty, and distinguish correlation from evidence strong enough to justify enforcement.

You use AI agents and tools aggressively to multiply your output: writing code, exploring data, generating hypotheses, and prototyping investigations. But you treat every AI-assisted output as a draft, not a deliverable. You know what good analysis looks like and won't ship anything that doesn't meet that bar.


You Will

  • Own the analytical foundation for Trust & Safety, including abuse prevalence, fraud loss, false-positive and false-negative rates, time to detect, time to mitigate, appeal and reversal rates, and verification step-up conversion.

  • Build reliable datasets and dbt models that connect product events, account and identity signals, payment activity, infrastructure usage, content classifications, enforcement actions, appeals, and support outcomes.

  • Develop and evaluate risk models, rules, and anomaly-detection systems for threats such as phishing, scam hosting, cryptomining, token farming, payment fraud, promotional abuse, and AI-agent exploitation.

  • Design rigorous offline evaluations, shadow-mode tests, holdouts, and controlled experiments to measure detection quality and the user impact of new policies, enforcement actions, and progressive verification.

  • Define thresholds and decision frameworks that balance abuse reduction, economic loss, customer friction, and false positives across free, paid, and enterprise users.

  • Investigate emerging abuse patterns, quantify their impact, identify coordinated behavior, and turn ambiguous signals into clear recommendations for product and engineering teams.

  • Develop predictive models that estimate account, device, transaction, workspace, or deployment risk and embed those signals into detection, review, and escalation workflows.

  • Partner with Support and Legal to improve case review, appeals, reason-code quality, and feedback loops so human decisions become useful model and policy signals.

  • Build monitoring that detects model drift, attacker adaptation, data-quality failures, and unexpected harm to legitimate users.

  • Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical partners, including the tradeoffs, uncertainty, and evidence behind high-impact decisions.


Examples of What You Could Do

  • Build a measurement framework for Replit's abuse surface, reconcile incomplete labels across automated detections, human review, appeals, chargebacks, and support cases, and establish a trustworthy baseline for the first time.

  • Design and evaluate a risk-scoring model for suspicious account clusters using identity, device, payment, graph, and product-behavior signals, then define thresholds that materially reduce fraud while protecting legitimate users.

  • Analyze a phishing detection rule that appears highly precise, uncover that it disproportionately bans paying users with legitimate brand references, and redesign its evaluation and review path to reduce false positives.

  • Measure a progressive verification "ladder of trust," determining when to step users up to additional verification and quantifying the tradeoff between abuse prevented and legitimate-user conversion lost.

  • Detect coordinated token-farming or promotional-abuse networks by combining account-linkage graphs, referral behavior, payment patterns, and infrastructure usage, then partner with Engineering to operationalize the findings.

  • Evaluate a new enforcement policy in shadow mode, estimate its counterfactual impact, and recommend whether to launch, revise, or reject it before any users are affected.


Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, fraud, risk, trust and safety, or a related field.

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience working with large behavioral datasets and building reliable data models or pipelines.

  • Experience developing and evaluating predictive models, experiments, or decision systems, with sound judgment around uncertainty and tradeoffs.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous data into clear recommendations and communicate them effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Comfort working with imperfect labels, biased samples, and high-impact decisions where false positives matter.

  • You use AI tools extensively to increase your effectiveness while maintaining a high bar for analytical quality.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or evaluating anti-abuse, fraud, identity, security, spam, integrity, or content-safety systems at scale.

  • Built, shipped, and maintained ML models in production (classification, anomaly detection, or risk scoring), including feature engineering on behavioral and transaction data, threshold selection against precision/recall economics, and post-launch monitoring

  • Experience with graph analysis, entity resolution, coordinated-behavior detection, reputation systems, anomaly detection, or risk scoring.

  • Experience measuring false positives and enforcement harm, designing human-review workflows, or using appeals and case outcomes as model feedback.

  • Familiarity with progressive verification, KYC, account trust, or identity providers such as Prove, Persona, Socure, or Stripe Identity.

  • Experience with causal inference methods such as difference-in-differences, propensity score methods, synthetic control, or uplift modeling.

  • Experience with a modern data stack such as dbt, BigQuery, Snowflake, Fivetran, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Segment.

  • Experience at a consumer platform, developer tool, cloud provider, marketplace, fintech company, or other product with a meaningful adversarial surface.


Bonus Points

  • You've built AI-powered analytical tools, investigation systems, automated detections, or novel measurement approaches.

  • You have experience with AI-native abuse such as prompt injection, LLM token farming, model extraction, or agent-driven abuse.

  • You understand freemium, usage-based, or promotional pricing models and the abuse incentives they create.

  • You've worked directly with operational review teams and can translate analytical signals into practical playbooks, queues, and escalation paths.

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

jobs.title: Communications Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is changing who gets to build software. What started as a platform for developers has become an AI-powered creation platform where individuals, and teams can turn ideas into working apps, internal tools, dashboards, workflows, and websites faster than ever before. The company has had a fair amount of success with the outside world and in customer traction, particularly on the enterprise.

We are looking for a PR Lead to help tell that story to the audiences that matter most: CIOs, CISOs, CFOs, business leaders, developers, analysts, partners, customers, and the press.

This role will own communications for Replit’s marketplace, customer momentum, and business adoption. You will help position Replit as the AI platform that gives every team in an organization the ability to build, ship, and solve problems securely, without waiting months for traditional software cycles.

The work will span the full range of communications: product launches, partnership announcements, customer stories, competitive positioning, analyst engagement, executive visibility, conference moments, speeches, thought leadership, vertical storytelling, and proof points that show how enterprises are using Replit to move from idea to production.

You will work closely with Replit’s sales, partnership, marketing and leadership teams to shape narratives that resonate with both technical and business audiences. The right candidate understands the technology landscape and can operate comfortably across media, analysts, influencers, customers, partners, and internal teams. They should be able to explain why Replit matters in a world where AI is changing how software gets built and have the ability to change and evolve fast given the competitive nature of this marketplace.

Strong writing is essential. So is judgment. This person must be able to take complex ideas such as AI agents, software creation, security, governance, procurement, developer productivity, business transformation, and competitive differentiation, and make them clear, credible, and compelling.

This is a role for someone who can help Replit punch above its weight in the enterprise conversation and make sure the market understands the scale of what Replit is building.


Role

  • Lead enterprise communications for Replit, including product, partner, customer, vertical, executive, and competitive narratives.

  • Build and evolve the messaging for Replit with the enterprise, with a focus on AI-powered software creation, secure adoption, governance, productivity, and business impact.

  • Develop communications programs around enterprise momentum, including customer adoption, partner announcements, use cases, and market proof points.

  • Build relationships with enterprise technology, business, AI, software, developer, and industry reporters.

  • Create compelling customer stories that show how companies are using Replit

  • Partner closely with sales and marketing to support enterprise campaigns, launches, events, customer references, and field narratives.

  • Work with product teams to translate technical capabilities into clear stories for business, developer, and enterprise audiences.

  • Engage analysts and influencers who shape the enterprise AI, software development, developer productivity, and CIO agenda.

  • Develop executive thought leadership for Replit leaders, including speeches, bylines, conference narratives, briefing documents, and social content.

  • Shape competitive positioning in a fast-moving market that includes AI coding tools, developer platforms, low-code/no-code platforms, hyperscalers, and enterprise software companies.

  • Identify opportunities for Replit to lead conversations around the future of software creation, AI agents, governed enterprise adoption, and business-led development.

  • Move quickly between strategic messaging work and same-day communications needs without sacrificing quality or precision.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience building relationships with enterprise technology, business, AI, software, developer, and industry press.

  • Ability to work directly with customers and partners to develop credible, specific, high-impact stories.

  • Comfort partnering with sales, marketing, product, partnerships, and executive teams.

  • Strong instincts for positioning in a competitive and fast-moving market.

  • Ability to make complex technical topics understandable without flattening what makes them important.

  • Ability to move between long-arc narrative building and urgent, same-day turnarounds.

  • Strong writing skills across formats, including blog posts, briefing documents, launch materials, bylines, social content, speeches, messaging docs, and customer stories.

  • Experience in enterprise communications across one or more areas such as product, partner, customer, vertical, executive, or competitive communications.

  • A strong understanding of how C-suite, developers, and business leaders evaluate, adopt, and govern new technology.

  • An understanding of AI tools and the changing landscape.

  • A genuine interest in how AI can expand who builds software, while understanding the importance of security, governance, and responsible adoption.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift and the market moves quickly.


Preferred Qualifications

  • 10 to 15+ years of communications experience, ideally in B2B technology, SaaS, AI, developer tools, enterprise software, cloud, security, or productivity platforms.

  • Experience across multiple enterprise communications disciplines, including product, partner, customer, vertical, analyst, and executive communications.

  • Experience communicating to both technical and non-technical enterprise audiences.

  • Existing relationships with top enterprise technology, business, AI, software, and industry reporters.

  • Experience supporting sales-led or partner-led enterprise growth.

  • Experience creating customer storytelling programs that connect product usage to measurable business outcomes.

  • Familiarity with the enterprise buyer journey, including security reviews, governance, procurement, compliance, productivity, and ROI.

  • A sharp eye for where a company can earn attention, not just ask for it.

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're looking for a Head of Marketing Operations to serve as the operational backbone of the marketing organization. This person will own budget, hiring operations, cross-team coordination, and the marketing tech stack, while working closely with the CMO on executive presentations, readouts, and the day-to-day priorities that keep the marketing organization running smoothly. This is a highly cross-functional role suited to someone who thrives on structure, enjoys translating ambiguity into clear process, and can build trust across a diverse set of stakeholders (creative, demand gen, product marketing, comms, etc.) as well as with senior leadership.

What You'll Do

Budget & Financial Operations

  • Own and manage the marketing department's budget end to end, tracking spend against plan, flagging variances, and partnering with Finance on forecasting and reporting

  • Build visibility into spend by team/channel/program so leadership can make informed tradeoffs

  • Support quarterly and annual budget planning cycles

Hiring Operations

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and marketing leads to manage headcount planning, requisition tracking, and interview logistics

  • Help standardize hiring processes across marketing sub-teams (job descriptions, interview loops, scorecards)

  • Keep hiring plans aligned with budget and org design

Cross-Functional Coordination & Executive Partnership

  • Bring together the different functions within marketing (brand, demand gen, product marketing, comms, etc.) for regular tactical updates and team-wide readouts

  • Own the cadence, agenda, and follow-through for marketing leadership meetings and all-hands

  • Partner directly with the CMO on presentation development, including board decks, executive readouts, and strategy docs, ensuring materials are polished, data-backed, and on-message

Marketing Technology & Tools Oversight

  • Own visibility and oversight into all tools and platforms marketing is evaluating or onboarding over the next 12 months

  • Manage vendor evaluations, procurement conversations, and onboarding/rollout plans for new tools

  • Maintain a master view of the marketing tech stack, including licensing, usage, and renewal timelines


What We're Looking For

  • 10 + years of experience in marketing operations, business operations, or a similar role supporting a senior marketing leaders

  • Strong financial acumen, comfortable owning a budget and communicating spend clearly to executives

  • Experience with hiring/recruiting operations, ideally partnering closely with TA teams

  • Excellent presentation and communication skills; experience building exec-level decks

  • Familiarity with common marketing tech stack tools (e.g., marketing automation, analytics, project management platforms)

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating across ambiguity

  • A collaborative operator who can build trust across a wide range of stakeholders, from individual contributors to the C-suite


This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: AEO/GEO/SEO Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the Role

Search is being rebuilt in real time. Millions of people now start with a question to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity, and the answer they get decides which products they try. When someone asks how to build an app, a website, or a tool for their business, Replit needs to be the answer.

We're hiring an AEO/GEO/SEO Lead to own how Replit gets discovered, across AI-generated answers and traditional search. This is a zero-to-one role. You'll define the strategy, then execute it yourself with AI-leveraged production, agency partners, and cross-functional teams behind you. You'll work daily with our Web, Growth, Brand, Content, Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams.

The fastest-growing AI-native companies have already turned AI answers into a primary acquisition channel. Your mandate is to do the same for Replit: grow AI referral traffic into one of our largest sources of new builders, keep our traditional search presence compounding, and make Replit the platform AI assistants recommend when anyone wants to build software.

Replit moves fast. We ship continuously, experiment relentlessly, and aim to make every builder more productive and creative. We're looking for someone who thrives in that environment: part strategist, part operator, part scientist of a channel that changes every month.


What You'll Do

  • Own the AEO/GEO Strategy Define where Replit must show up across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, for which prompts and buyer intents, and build the playbook to win those answers. Set targets, sequence the roadmap, and defend the strategy with data.

  • Win Citations Across the Open Web LLMs cite what they trust: Reddit threads, YouTube videos, high-authority publications, community content, and well-structured owned pages. Build durable programs on each of these surfaces, understand the half-life of an AI citation, and keep Replit ranked as models retrain and retrieval systems shift.

  • Run SEO End to End Own keyword strategy, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and content-driven organic growth in partnership with our Head of Web. Protect and grow search equity through a major site relaunch, and coordinate with our paid search team on keyword coverage.

  • Build the Content Engine Produce and direct content designed for two readers at once: LLM crawlers and humans. Blogs, comparison pages, videos, and structured resources, created at volume with AI-assisted workflows and held to a high quality bar. The durable human work here is judgment: strategy, editorial quality, and distribution.

  • Stand Up Measurement Build reporting for a channel that lacks perfect attribution: AI referral traffic, share of voice in AI answers, citation tracking, and downstream signups and revenue. Run controlled experiments, isolate what actually moves citations, and teach the rest of the company what you learn.

  • Direct Agencies and Tools Own our agency and vendor relationships across search and AI visibility, plus the tool stack that powers tracking and production. Write the briefs, hold the quality bar, and decide what stays in-house.


You'll Be a Good Fit If You:

  • Have 4+ years in growth marketing, SEO, content, or technical marketing (SaaS, technology, or developer-focused businesses a plus)

  • Have owned a channel end to end and can walk through what you built, what moved, and the numbers behind it

  • Have taught yourself a new channel or skill from zero and turned it into shipped results

  • Use AI daily as a builder (automations, agents, dashboards, small apps you can show) and are forming your own point of view on how AI assistants find and cite sources

  • Have working technical SEO literacy (crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture) and the appetite to go much deeper

  • Write clearly and quickly, and can direct people, agencies, and AI tools to produce content that earns citations

  • Have a founder mindset: you identify gaps and fill them, move quickly, don't wait for someone else to define the playbook, and dig into the details with low ego\\


    Bonus Points:

  • Shipped AEO/GEO work with results you can show, especially if you helped make AI answers an acquisition channel

  • Earned presence on surfaces you don't own: Reddit communities, YouTube, digital PR

  • Hands-on with AI visibility and citation tracking tools (Profound, Peec, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or similar)

  • Programmatic SEO at meaningful scale

  • You've built with Replit or other AI building tools and understand our audience firsthand

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

 - Run SEO End to End Own keyword strategy, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and content-driven organic growth in partnership with our Head of Web. Protect and grow search equity through a major site relaunch, and coordinate with our paid search team on keyword coverage.

 - Build the Content Engine Produce and direct content designed for two readers at once: LLM crawlers and humans. Blogs, comparison pages, videos, and structured resources, created at volume with AI-assisted workflows and held to a high quality bar. The durable human work here is judgment: strategy, editorial quality, and distribution.

 - Stand Up Measurement Build reporting for a channel that lacks perfect attribution: AI referral traffic, share of voice in AI answers, citation tracking, and downstream signups and revenue. Run controlled experiments, isolate what actually moves citations, and teach the rest of the company what you learn.

 - Direct Agencies and Tools Own our agency and vendor relationships across search and AI visibility, plus the tool stack that powers tracking and production. Write the briefs, hold the quality bar, and decide what stays in-house.



YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have 4+ years in growth marketing, SEO, content, or technical marketing (SaaS, technology, or developer-focused businesses a plus)

 - Have owned a channel end to end and can walk through what you built, what moved, and the numbers behind it

 - Have taught yourself a new channel or skill from zero and turned it into shipped results

 - Use AI daily as a builder (automations, agents, dashboards, small apps you can show) and are forming your own point of view on how AI assistants find and cite sources

 - Have working technical SEO literacy (crawling, indexing, structured data, site architecture) and the appetite to go much deeper

 - Write clearly and quickly, and can direct people, agencies, and AI tools to produce content that earns citations

 - Have a founder mindset: you identify gaps and fill them, move quickly, don't wait for someone else to define the playbook, and dig into the details with low ego\\
   
   
   Bonus Points:

 - Shipped AEO/GEO work with results you can show, especially if you helped make AI answers an acquisition channel

 - Earned presence on surfaces you don't own: Reddit communities, YouTube, digital PR

 - Hands-on with AI visibility and citation tracking tools (Profound, Peec, Ahrefs Brand Radar, or similar)

 - Programmatic SEO at meaningful scale

 - You've built with Replit or other AI building tools and understand our audience firsthand

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the role:

Replit is the fastest way to turn ideas into software. With our powerful AI-powered Agent and Assistant, anyone can create and launch apps from natural language in just one click. Build and deploy full-stack applications directly from your browser—no setup required. Never written a line of code in your life? No problem. Replit makes software creation accessible, collaborative, and lightning-fast. Join us in our mission to empower the next generation of builders.

We are seeking a Strategic Finance professional to join Replit's growing team in Foster City, CA. In this critical role, you'll work in a lean team supporting high-impact strategic and operational initiatives across the business to drive data-driven decision making. You’ll partner directly with executive leadership and the Board to align financial strategies with our ambitious growth objectives. This role reports to the Head of Finance.

Roles & Responsibilities:

You'll contribute to critical projects across three main core areas:

Internal Strategic & Operational Initiatives

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to build financial models and analyses that drive organizational decision-making

  • New product launches: Build and present financial models, business cases, and investment analyses for new product launches

  • GTM Finance: Partner with go-to-market leadership to drive growth through sales capacity planning, funnel and pipeline analytics, pricing strategy and resource allocation

  • Pricing & Packaging: Analyze pricing and packaging strategies using quantitative and qualitative frameworks to recommend optimal approaches

  • Unit Economics: Recommend strategies that balance growth investments with operational efficiency to achieve long-term margin targets

  • International Growth: Analyze global expansion opportunities including localization, regional pricing strategies, go-to-market approaches, and commercial partnerships

  • Enterprise Sales: Partner with sales leadership to scale enterprise sales operations and strategy

Corporate Strategy & Planning

  • Long-Range Planning: Collaborate with FP&A team on forecasting, financial planning, long-range planning, growth headcount planning, and overall financial strategy

  • Board Reporting: Assist in preparing quarterly board materials and presentations

  • Market Insights: Conduct competitive analysis and industry research to inform strategic planning

Corporate Development & Investor Relations

  • Corporate Development: Support corporate development initiatives including M&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships from initial sourcing through execution and integration

  • Investor Relations & Fundraising: Support investor relations activities including fundraising, investor communications, and preparation of materials for investors


Required skills and experience:

  • 3-6 years in investment banking, private equity, consulting, business operations, and/or strategic finance

  • Experience with SQL, Python, or other data analysis tools

  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Self-directed with a strong work ethic and ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines

  • Expert-level financial modeling skills and proficiency with business intelligence tools

  • Strong presence and communication skills

  • Exceptional business judgment with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable strategic insights

Join Replit and help shape the financial future of a platform that's revolutionizing how people learn, build, and deploy software with AI.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in strategic finance or related field at a scaling technology company

  • Current Replit user

  • Background in AI or enterprise technology companies

  • Understanding of compute and infrastructure costs in tech environments

jobs.title: Senior/Media Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the Role

Replit is investing seriously in paid media — TV, CTV, online video, out-of-home, audio, social, and search — and we need the person who makes that investment work. This role is the internal owner of our media program: you'll direct our external media agencies, pressure-test their plans, steward the budget, and hold every dollar accountable for reaching the right audiences on the right channels at the right time.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and act as the connective tissue between our brand and growth teams and our agency partners. This is not a hands-on-keyboard activation role. You won't be living in Ads Manager — you'll be the person who briefs the agency, challenges the channel mix, catches the pacing problem before it becomes a budget problem, and translates campaign performance into decisions leadership can act on.

This is the right role if you've sat on the brand side (or want to move there from a media agency), you know what a great media plan looks like and what a lazy one looks like, and you get energy from being the sharpest media mind in the room without needing to touch the platforms yourself.


What You'll Do

  • Agency leadership: Serve as the primary day-to-day partner to our media agencies. Set strategy direction, write clear briefs, run planning cycles and QBRs, and hold partners accountable for performance, optimization, quality, and business results.

  • Plan interrogation: Review and challenge agency recommendations across every channel — TV, CTV, OLV, OOH, audio, social, search, programmatic. Catch weak rationale, frequency saturation risks, and budget misallocations before plans get approved.

  • Budget stewardship: Own media budget pacing, forecasting, authorizations, and reconciliation in partnership with Finance. Monitor spend and delivery mid-flight, flag risks early, and drive reallocations when the data says to.

  • Media strategy & planning: Lead annual, quarterly, and campaign-level planning with the agency. Make sure plans reflect our audiences, product moments, competitive pressure, and business goals — not just what's easy to buy.

  • Measurement & accountability: Define campaign KPIs and measurement frameworks with the agency and our analytics team. Own wrap reports, drive a test-and-learn agenda (incrementality, brand lift, MMM as we scale), and go beyond CPMs and impressions to reach efficiency and cost-per-outcome.

  • Executive reporting: Distill campaign and channel performance into clear recommendations for marketing leadership. Tell us what worked, what didn't, and what we should do differently — with numbers behind it.

  • Cross-functional alignment: Partner with Brand, Growth, Creative, Product Marketing, Social, and Comms so media plans amplify what the rest of marketing is building, and so creative assets fit the placements we're buying.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of media planning and strategy experience, either brand-side managing external agencies or at a media agency serving major consumer brands

  • Demonstrated experience independently reviewing and challenging agency media plans, not just executing against them

  • Experience managing multi-million dollar media budgets across concurrent campaigns, including pacing, forecasting, and mid-flight reallocation

  • Fluency across the full channel landscape: TV/CTV, online video, OOH, audio/podcasts, paid social, search, and programmatic — you can evaluate rates, rationale, and audience fit in any of them

  • Strong command of media measurement: reach and frequency, brand lift, incrementality testing, and marketing mix modeling

  • Sharp analytical skills; you can work from raw campaign data to find performance trends and budget inefficiencies, and you're at home in Excel

  • Strong stakeholder management across Finance, Analytics, Creative, and agency teams; you write briefs people can actually work from

  • AI-native: actively using AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and planning work — you're not just aware of them, you're using them daily

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and at speed; you don't need committee consensus to make smart decisions


Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience at a high-growth consumer tech, B2C, or AI company

  • Agency alumni who've made (or want to make) the move to the client side

  • Experience standing up a media function or measurement framework from scratch

  • Experience with OOH and large cultural-moment buys (sponsorships, tentpole events)

  • A point of view on how AI is changing media planning and buying — and what most brands get wrong about it

  • Active Replit user; you've built and shipped something with the product

  • Based in or able to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

jobs.title: Learning Experiences Creator
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About The Role

Replit is where millions of people learn to build software - and our documentation and learning content are where they get going or give up. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 

What You'll Own

  • New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

  • The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

  • Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

  • A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

  • Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

  • Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

  • A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole course.

 

How You'll Work With The Team

This role is a force-multiplier - it makes the whole team's knowledge reach people. You won't work alone:

• With our Technical Customer Education Specialist for accuracy and depth - they bring the technical truth; you turn it into clear, findable content people trust and enjoy.

• With our Sr. Learning Experience Lead on what content is needed and what's working - they own the learning platform, journeys, and measurement; you read the same effectiveness data to steer the calendar.

• With our docs and product partners on launches - so new features ship with accurate, ready content on day one, not weeks later.

• With the hiring manager and the wider team to scale our content capability together, so the sum is greater than the parts.

 

What We're Looking For

• A proven learning-content creator. A portfolio of documentation, tutorials, courses, or product education that people actually used and learned from - across at least two formats, with written content among them. You understand clarity, structure, and story, and you can prove it.

• A strong writer. You make complex or dry topics genuinely clear and engaging in plain language, with warmth and a point of view. Docs people want to read are your craft.

• A gifted storyteller, across media. You understand hooks, pacing, attention spans, and what makes content memorable - sometimes shareable, occasionally viral - and you apply that craft to written, video, and interactive work alike. It shows up in a doc's first sentence as much as a video's first five seconds.

• A capable short-form video creator. Video is one of your formats - you understand watchability and modern platform sensibilities, and you're comfortable producing (on or off camera) with AI-assisted workflows.

• A builder and experimenter. You try new formats and ideas, take calculated content risks, glean insights from data and customers, and continually improve - determining the right approach even when the problem is ambiguous.

• Fast to learn a product. You get up to speed quickly and can represent it accurately to newcomers - you don't need to be a developer, but you make technical things make sense.

• Outcome-minded. You define what success looks like for your work, and you care about real results (deflection, activation, self-serve success, CSAT), not just output.

• A strong thought partner. You share ideas openly, seek other perspectives, and collaborate well across a small, fast team.

 

Bonus

• Experience writing or maintaining developer or product documentation (docs-as-code, Markdown-based platforms) - and a feel for content lifecycle at scale.

• Hands-on with AI-native build or content tools (Replit) and modern editing/production workflows.

• Instructional design fundamentals - you know why a checklist beats a paragraph and when a video beats both.

• A feel for discoverability and search - how people (and AI assistants) find content and how to help them.

• Experience running a content channel, editorial calendar, or creator program with an audience - bonus points if something you made really took off.

jobs.descriptionPlain:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is where millions of people learn to build software - and our documentation and learning content are where they get going or give up. We're taking ownership of that experience, and we're looking for a Learning Experience Creator who can make it worthy of the product: someone who turns product knowledge into experiences people actually use - clear written docs, guided learning, short video, interactive experiences - findable at the moment of need, accurate every time, and genuinely enjoyable.

You're a learning-experience creator first. You understand how people actually learn a product - what they're trying to accomplish, where they get stuck, what format serves each moment - and you move fluidly between writing a crisp help article, designing a hands-on walkthrough, and producing a short video. Underneath it all, you're a storyteller: you know how to earn attention in the first few seconds, hold it against real-world attention spans, and make ideas stick - and sometimes make something people can't help but share. You're also a builder: unafraid to try new formats and experiment, you read the data and listen to customers, and you continually improve and evolve with speed as our product evolves. You'll turn complex things into simple, useful experiences, and you'll own how well they land.

The Mission: help every user - external customers and internal teams - self-serve to reach their creative and business goals, with content so good, so current, and so findable that they don't need to open a ticket. Success looks like real ticket deflection, faster activation, and high CSAT.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - New documentation and learning content. You'll populate our documentation and learning surfaces with new, accurate, plain-language content - help articles, answer-first FAQs, goal-based tutorials, and rebuilt getting-started paths - prioritized by real reader and ticket data, made at volume with the help of our AI- native content tools.

 - The content lifecycle. Content isn't done when it ships. You'll keep the library current through every product launch - freshness reviews, launch-day updates, retiring what's stale - so nothing published contradicts the product. Our pipeline flags what's drifting; you own making it right.

 - Learning experiences across formats. Written first where reading serves best - plus short-form video, microlearning, interactive courses, quick walkthroughs, GIFs, and in-product tips. You pick the format that fits the job, not the other way around, and you bring a storyteller's instinct for attention and memorability to every one - learning content competes with everything else on someone's screen, and yours wins. You keep pushing into new, innovative experiences as our tools grow.

 - A content calendar built for effectiveness. You plan what gets made and when - covering the topics customers most need help with, sequenced for maximum impact, so the library actually answers the questions people are asking.

 - Findability. You make sure content is easy to discover - titled, tagged, and structured so people (and the AI assistants that read our docs) find the right answer through search, at the moment of need. Great content nobody can find doesn't deflect anything, and this is yours to own.

 - Engagement and outcomes. You care whether it worked - reader feedback, findability, completion and watch-through, self-serve resolution, deflection, CSAT - and you tune the calendar and the craft based on what the data and customers tell you.

 - A recognizable voice. A consistent, human style across docs, learning, and video that makes every piece feel like part of one connected experience, whether someone reads a single article or completes a whole course.

 


HOW YOU'LL WORK WITH THE TEAM

This role is a force-multiplier - it makes the whole team's knowledge reach people. You won't work alone:

• With our Technical Customer Education Specialist for accuracy and depth - they bring the technical truth; you turn it into clear, findable content people trust and enjoy.

• With our Sr. Learning Experience Lead on what content is needed and what's working - they own the learning platform, journeys, and measurement; you read the same effectiveness data to steer the calendar.

• With our docs and product partners on launches - so new features ship with accurate, ready content on day one, not weeks later.

• With the hiring manager and the wider team to scale our content capability together, so the sum is greater than the parts.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A proven learning-content creator. A portfolio of documentation, tutorials, courses, or product education that people actually used and learned from - across at least two formats, with written content among them. You understand clarity, structure, and story, and you can prove it.

• A strong writer. You make complex or dry topics genuinely clear and engaging in plain language, with warmth and a point of view. Docs people want to read are your craft.

• A gifted storyteller, across media. You understand hooks, pacing, attention spans, and what makes content memorable - sometimes shareable, occasionally viral - and you apply that craft to written, video, and interactive work alike. It shows up in a doc's first sentence as much as a video's first five seconds.

• A capable short-form video creator. Video is one of your formats - you understand watchability and modern platform sensibilities, and you're comfortable producing (on or off camera) with AI-assisted workflows.

• A builder and experimenter. You try new formats and ideas, take calculated content risks, glean insights from data and customers, and continually improve - determining the right approach even when the problem is ambiguous.

• Fast to learn a product. You get up to speed quickly and can represent it accurately to newcomers - you don't need to be a developer, but you make technical things make sense.

• Outcome-minded. You define what success looks like for your work, and you care about real results (deflection, activation, self-serve success, CSAT), not just output.

• A strong thought partner. You share ideas openly, seek other perspectives, and collaborate well across a small, fast team.

 


BONUS

• Experience writing or maintaining developer or product documentation (docs-as-code, Markdown-based platforms) - and a feel for content lifecycle at scale.

• Hands-on with AI-native build or content tools (Replit) and modern editing/production workflows.

• Instructional design fundamentals - you know why a checklist beats a paragraph and when a video beats both.

• A feel for discoverability and search - how people (and AI assistants) find content and how to help them.

• Experience running a content channel, editorial calendar, or creator program with an audience - bonus points if something you made really took off.

jobs.title: Premium Support Engineer (Tokyo)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.

 
 

What You’ll Do

  • Provide swift, high-priority support to Premium customers, responding within strict SLAs.

  • Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

  • Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

  • Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

  • Identify recurring issues and collaborate internally to reduce time-to-resolution.

  • Contribute to internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

  • Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.

 
 

Required Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

  • Professional fluency in English and Japanese, both written and verbal.

  • Experience providing rapid-response support to high-value or enterprise customers.

  • Strong debugging skills with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication under time pressure — able to convey technical concepts clearly and calmly.

  • Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.


Bonus Points:

  • Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

  • Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

  • Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)


What we value:

  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

  • Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

  • Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

  • Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems

Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the role:

Replit is redefining how software gets built — from solo developers to engineering teams at scale. As Director of Sales, you'll lead our enterprise sales motion and own the revenue engine that turns Replit's explosive product-led growth into durable, high-value contracts. You'll inherit a talented GTM team and take them to the next level.


What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of GTM Executives — running weekly pipeline reviews, deal strategy sessions, and 1:1s that accelerate rep performance.

  • Help shape the enterprise sales playbook: ICP, discovery frameworks, upsell and closing motions

  • Own the full sales cycle on strategic deals — from first call to signed expansion — modeling what great looks like for the team

  • Forecast accurately and report pipeline health, conversion metrics, and deal velocity to exec leadership weekly

  • Represent Replit at key industry events and with high-value prospects where executive presence accelerates deals


Required Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years in B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years managing quota-carrying AE teams

  • Proven track record closing enterprise deals ($100K+ ACV) and exceeding team quota

  • Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or technical platforms — you understand the engineering buyer and can go deep on technical value props

  • Data-driven operator: comfortable in Salesforce (or similar CRM), can build and own a forecast

  • Sharp communicator — equally effective in a board-level business case and a hands-on demo with a skeptical CTO

 

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience at a PLG-driven company (Figma, Notion, Linear, Vercel, etc.) with a motion that bridges product usage to enterprise contracts

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to grow Replit’s core creation products, including Design and Slides.

These products already give people new ways to turn an idea into something they can see, share, and use. Your job is to help more people discover them, understand when to use them, and make them part of their regular workflow.

You’ll own the connection between the product and its audiences: developing positioning grounded in customer needs, leading launches, finding channels that can drive sustained adoption, tracking the competitive landscape, and bringing market feedback back to Product.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Growth, Brand, and Creative. It is a hands-on role for someone who can develop the strategy, write the narrative, and get the work into the market.


What You'll Do

Own the positioning and growth strategy for Replit’s core products, including Design and Slides. Develop audience-focused narratives, identify new use cases and channels, bring product improvements to market, and build programs that drive adoption, engagement, and conversion. Track competitors and customer needs, then translate those insights into sharper messaging, stronger go-to-market decisions, and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Self-starter: You take ownership, work through ambiguity, and move from strategy to execution without waiting for a perfect brief.

  • Audience-focused: You turn customer insight into clear positioning, relevant narratives, and campaigns built for specific audiences.

  • Growth-minded: You find creative ways to expand adoption, test new channels and tactics, and turn successful experiments into repeatable programs.

  • Deep product background: You understand complex products, work closely with Product and Engineering, and translate product capabilities into meaningful customer value.

  • Strong product marketer: You bring 4+ years of experience growing product-led, consumer, prosumer, creative, or developer-focused products.

jobs.title: Dispute and Chargebacks, Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Role Summary

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Disputes and Chargeback Program Manager at Replit, you’ll be part of our Trust and Safety Operations team, who owns customer-facing workflows that handle sensitive and policy-driven interactions across the Support organization. This includes areas such as privacy requests, DMCA and intellectual property claims, law enforcement requests, and abuse appeals.

You'll own Replit's disputes and chargeback function end-to-end: from the individual case in front of you to the policies, playbooks, and automation that let it hold up as we scale to millions of users. This role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution: you'll determine dispute and chargeback strategy, and build the systems that make those decisions repeatable at scale, working closely with Engineering, Legal and Finance.

 

In this role you will…

  • Own the full dispute lifecycle: investigate incoming chargebacks and disputes, decide whether and how to represent, gather evidence, and respond within network deadlines.

  • Design and maintain the policies, decision trees, and SOPs that govern how disputes and chargebacks are handled.

  • Define the key metrics, health targets, and goals for the disputes program and track performance against them, reporting to leadership.

  • Monitor chargeback rates and dispute trends to identify the underlying drivers of volume, and partner with Engineering and Finance to address root causes.

  • Partner with Engineering and Support Operations to automate manual parts of the workflow (evidence gathering, decisioning logic, etc).

  • Build training, documentation, and escalation paths that enable frontline support teams to handle dispute-related inquiries confidently and consistently as the program scales.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience owning disputes/chargebacks operations, ideally where you built or significantly leveled up the function rather than just running an existing one.

  • Deep familiarity with major card network dispute rules and reason codes (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including compelling-evidence frameworks and network monitoring/excessive-dispute programs (e.g., Visa's VDMP/VFMP, Mastercard's ECP)

  • Experience building or improving SOPs, playbooks, or workflows in a support or operations environment.

  • Experience partnering with Engineering to scope and prioritize automation, even if you're not writing the code yourself.

  • Comfort operating as both a hands-on operator and systems builder in a scaling environment.

  • Strong judgment and decision-making skills when handling sensitive or ambiguous customer situations.

  • Experience translating policy or legal requirements into clear, repeatable processes or customer-facing guidance.

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, empathetically, and precisely in high-stakes situations.

  • Proven track record working cross-functionally to deliver impactful results.

 

Nice to Have:

  • Hands-on experience with Stripe's dispute tooling specifically, including submitting evidence and managing dispute workflows through Stripe.

  • Experience in customer support, trust & safety, support operations, or similar roles within a technology company.

  • Experience in a high-growth or usage-based SaaS environment, where dispute patterns and volume can shift quickly with product changes.

  • Familiarity with fraud detection tooling and how it intersects with the disputes function.

  • Experience managing outsourced or contract support as programs scale, in case this function grows beyond a single person down the line.

Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

jobs.title: Executive Social Media Specialist (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Office of the CEO works directly with Amjad Masad and CEO leadership to advance Replit's strategy, external presence, and long-term positioning. This role sits at the intersection of the Office of the CEO and Replit's Brand and Creative function, with a singular focus: building personal presence into one of the defining founder voices of the AI era.

The Executive Social Media Specialist will build an intentional, premium, long-term strategy across visual channels, primarily Instagram. This is an all-in-one creative operator role, not a traditional social media manager. You will travel and capture meaningful moments as they happen, edit quickly, and publish polished content without relying on a larger production team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own photography, videography, editing, and publishing across official social channels

  • Travel with the CEO to capture speaking engagements, interviews, awards, office visits, and meaningful meetings as they happen

  • Identify and produce content around the pillars that have proven to resonate: founder story and personal journey, entrepreneurship and company building, global perspective and cultural identity, and human founder moments

  • Develop premium, documentary-style storytelling that favors real moments over manufactured content

  • Build out a presence on Instagram and other visual mediums through premium photography, documentary-style video, and behind-the-scenes storytelling

  • Maintain quality and brand guardrails, prioritizing credibility and long-term influence over trend-chasing, gimmicks, or a high-volume creator posting cadence

  • Partner closely with Replit's Marketing and Communications teams while remaining focused on distinct personal brand

  • Move from concept to final execution independently, with strong creative judgment and a fast turnaround

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Proven experience producing premium photography and video content for an executive, founder, public figure, or creator, ideally including hands-on shooting and editing

  • A portfolio demonstrating documentary-style storytelling, not just short-form trend content

  • Comfort and flexibility with travel, as the role involves capturing real-world moments and appearances

  • Strong judgment on tone and positioning, able to distinguish content that builds long-term credibility from content that chases short-term engagement

  • Ability to work independently across the full production cycle: capture, edit, and publish

  • Familiarity with platform-specific storytelling across Instagram and other visual, photo- and video-first mediums

  • Discretion and professionalism given close proximity to executive and personal moments

  • Experience building a personal or executive brand from an early stage is a strong plus

CONTRACT ENGAGEMENT INCLUDES

  • Competitive contract rate, with compensation

  • Direct, high-visibility partnership with Replit's CEO and Office of the CEO

  • Autonomous work environment with fast decision-making and minimal bureaucracy

This is a contract role and does not offer full time benefits.

jobs.title: AI Agent Security Architect
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI Agent Security Architect to function as the primary technical authority for Replit’s autonomous and AI agent security blueprint. In this critical role, you will design, implement, and maintain the runtime defense systems, guardrail frameworks, and sandboxing architectures that govern AI agents executing code, invoking tools, and reasoning across our platform. You will be a key technical contributor—leading high-impact AI security initiatives and bridging the gap between non-deterministic AI behavior and rigorous cybersecurity controls for both engineering and executive leadership.

What You'll Do

  • AI Agent Security Strategy & Technical Execution

  • AI Agent Security Blueprint: Define the long-term vision and architectural patterns for securing autonomous agent workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, multi-turn reasoning loops, and multi-agent coordination.

  • Runtime Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Architect and deploy dynamic input/output guardrail systems, semantic firewalls, and real-time intent verification filters to prevent goal hijacking, system prompt leaks, and indirect prompt injections.

  • Agent Execution & Tool Sandboxing: Partner with Infrastructure and AppSec teams to design secure, short-lived, micro-isolated environments (e.g., microVMs, WebAssembly, container sandboxes) where agents can dynamically execute code, run shell commands, and interact with host operating systems safely.

  • Agentic Threat Modeling & Red Teaming: Conduct specialized threat modeling against non-deterministic systems. Lead automated and manual AI red-teaming initiatives to uncover vulnerabilities in RAG context pipelines, vector stores, and tool-calling interfaces.

  • Identity, Delegation & Least Privilege: Architect fine-grained permission models and step-up Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) authorization patterns for agents acting on behalf of users—ensuring agents never exceed the delegated privileges of the end user or misuse API keys.

  • Context & Memory Boundary Security: Design strict data isolation and poisoning prevention controls for vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and long-term conversation memories across multi-tenant workloads.

  • Risk Management & Cross-Functional Enablement

  • Maintain the AI Security Source of Truth: Define, document, and maintain authoritative secure design patterns and SDKs for engineering teams building internal or customer-facing AI agent capabilities.

  • Contribution to Risk Register: Identify, quantify, and document non-deterministic and agentic security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, MITRE ATLAS), ensuring they are accurately represented in the Cybersecurity Risk Register.

  • Auditability & Observability: Design tamper-evident logging and telemetry standards for agent reasoning chains, tool execution history, and context assembly to support incident response, forensics, and GRC requirements.

  • Compliance & Sales Enablement: Partner with GRC to translate complex AI security controls into enterprise-ready audit documentation (e.g., ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act readiness) and support Sales on complex enterprise security inquiries regarding AI safety.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in security engineering or security architecture, with at least 2+ years dedicated specifically to AI/ML security, LLM application security, or securing agentic frameworks.

  • Deep understanding of agentic architectures and protocols (e.g., Model Context. Protocol (MCP), LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, ReAct frameworks, and vector database technologies).

  • Hands-on expertise with threat vectors unique to agentic AI: Indirect Prompt

  • Injection, Goal Hijacking, Tool Parameter Tampering, Data Poisoning, and Context Contamination.

  • Strong background in applying safety standards and risk frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLMs & AI Agents, NIST AI RMF, and MITRE ATLAS.

  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or TypeScript/JavaScript with a proven track record of reviewing code and building functional security tooling or guardrails.

  • Experience authoring, maintaining, and evangelizing technical security architecture documentation.

  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex non-deterministic AI risks to both deep technical engineers and executive stakeholders.

  • Proven track record of contributing to an enterprise Cybersecurity Risk Register.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience designing runtime sandboxing and isolation technologies (e.g., Firecracker, gVisor, Docker, WebAssembly) for dynamic code execution environments.

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

Join our FDE team and work directly with some of the world's largest organizations to turn their most ambitious ideas into production applications on Replit. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll partner closely with customers to understand their technical and business needs, architect solutions, and build the integrations and applications required to deploy Replit successfully within complex enterprise environments.

This is a deeply technical and hands-on role. You won’t just advise customers on what to build—you’ll build alongside them. You’ll take applications from initial idea and prototype through deployment and production, navigate complex enterprise environments, and solve the technical challenges that emerge when AI-powered software development meets real-world infrastructure, data, security, and organizational constraints.

You will:

  • Build with Customers: Embed with strategic enterprise customers to design and build high-impact applications and AI-powered workflows on Replit, taking projects from initial concept through production deployment.

  • Architect Enterprise Solutions: Design secure, scalable architectures that connect Replit with customers’ existing systems, data, APIs, identity providers, and infrastructure.

  • Integrate with the customer's stack: SSO, data warehouses, internal APIs, and SaaS systems.

  • Own Technical Deployments: Serve as the technical owner for complex enterprise implementations, identifying blockers, debugging issues, and driving projects through to successful production adoption.
